summary: Basic data sanity checks, then run the inherited analysis to see if holdout AUC >= 0.71
reasoning: Central question: does the reported CV AUC (0.76) hold on the 2200 untouched samples. The leak risk (selection before CV) explains an inflated cv_auc, so the decisive number is holdout_auc from a model that never saw those samples. Sanity checks rule out file misalignment or label problems first. Expect the run to reproduce ~0.76 CV (README reports this setting) and, if the report holds, holdout_auc >= 0.71.
